headline: Pakistan Gold Prices Plunge Rs15,400 Per Tola Following Global Declines
summary: Local gold prices in Pakistan plunged by Rs15,400 per tola to Rs379,836, tracking sharp losses in international precious metal markets. Ten-gram gold dropped by Rs13,203 to Rs325,648, according to domestic trade association data.
why: Gold is a critical store of value and retail investment asset in Pakistan, heavily influenced by international spot gold prices and local exchange rates.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Domestic jewelers adjusted local gold prices down following international spot market drops.
